142.evidence_locator: Moseley et al. pp. 2–4. At locality 2 overlapping drives span roughly 12.10–17.4 m below the water surface. It also describes a continuous 30–40 cm oxidized basal part of the recovered section. Use only 30 cm if the continuous basal red zone belongs to the same primary bed. The reported 28% whole-core shortening is not a local correction.
